scientific_integrity: The external uniformity theorem is credited and not presented as new. Exact finite enumeration corroborates only small sizes; all-limit and smoothness claims depend on the analytic proof. Self-review only; no independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to ordered binary-tree automorphism permutations, equivalently general scalar uniform-angle butterfly GEPP pivots, and does not cover other random matrix ensembles or other Sylow embeddings. The independent swap representation and exact smooth law are derived here from previously established uniformity; historical priority may be affected by an unlocated general iterated-wreath inversion theorem.
title: Smooth macroscopic inversion fluctuations of random butterfly pivot permutations
